name: fast-jev-output
description: Trim long Bash output with Jev before the model sees it (Claude Code plugin)

apiKey.title: TypeSafe API key
apiKey.description: TypeSafe API key. Leave unset to use TYPESAFE_API_KEY.

minTokens.title: Minimum Bash output tokens
minTokens.description: Stdout at or below this estimated token count passes through untouched. Minimum: 10000.

persistedOutputs.title: Prune output the engine saved
persistedOutputs.description: When Bash output is too large to show inline, prune the saved file instead of leaving the model a head-of-file preview.

persistedMaxChars.title: Budget for engine-saved output
persistedMaxChars.description: Rendered character budget including omission markers and the archive footer. If errors or unscored content cannot fit safely, the original result passes through. 0 disables the cap.

chunkLines.title: Bash output chunk lines
chunkLines.description: Number of Bash output lines grouped into each Jev chunk.

keepThreshold.title: Keep threshold
keepThreshold.description: Minimum Jev probability for a Bash output chunk to stay visible.

maxStateTokens.title: Maximum Jev state tokens
maxStateTokens.description: Estimated token budget for the Bash output state sent to Jev.
